subject: MAP: security gating, evidence cadence & DPA retention appendix
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@heliosfin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Torres <ana.torres@heliosfin.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security gating & evidence cadence – first pass

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked Redwood's throughput profile. We want to align on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on security gates for our evaluation. High-level asks from Helios:

- SOC 2 Type II report (summary + any outstanding corrective actions)
- SIG/CAIQ responses (we can take the CAIQ spreadsheet)
- Draft DPA redlines and retention regime for EU/US customers
- An evidence cadence (owners/dates) so our audit team can schedule reviews

Can you share a proposed MAP with milestones and an evidence matrix by next Wednesday (6/7)? We need signal on whether Redwood will accept the <90-day retention carveouts we discussed for test telemetry.

Attachments: brief product notes from our side (none attached here).

Best,
Josh (Procurement)
Helios Financial

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@heliosfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gating & evidence cadence – first pass

Josh — thanks for the clear list.

High-level reply:
- SOC 2 Type II: we can provide the full report and a one-page findings summary.
- SIG/CAIQ: we have a completed CAIQ export and an internal mapping doc; I'll surface the CSV.
- DPA redlines: legal will propose markups; kim will lead intake.
- Retention: Redwood supports region-based retention; default hosted retention is 30 days for request metadata and 90 days for full traces unless customer elects a longer term. We can discuss a 90-day test telemetry exception — details below.

I'll draft a 6-week MAP with milestone owners and upload an evidence_matrix_v3.csv by EOD Tuesday (6/6).

Quick note on the retention exception: we can support a limited 90-day hold for non-production test telemetry under a scoped DPA appendix if Helios commits to an evidence destruction schedule and a constrained consumer subset. Marcus, can you add notes on operational controls?

Thanks,
Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gating & evidence cadence – first pass

Mina / Kim — adding operational detail for the MAP (draft bullets to include in the evidence matrix):

- SOC 2 evidence owner: Security Ops (Marcus) — timeline to hand over control logs: 2 weeks after NDA
- CAIQ mapping: RDW-CAIQ v2 exported; we will attach a mapped implementation note per control (owner + artifact link)
- KV / prompt data: isolated in a tenant store, AES-256 at rest; test telemetry flagged with header x-helio-test:true for retention scoping
- Retention mechanics: automated lifecycle job to purge flagged test telemetry at 90 days (runs nightly). We will include a Runbook entry and a sample job config in the matrix.

I'll prepare the artifacts referenced in evidence_matrix_v3.csv and add links to the Drive folder.

Marcus
Director, Reliability Engineering

From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@heliosfin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@heliosfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP: security gating & evidence cadence – first pass

Thanks Mina / Marcus — this looks promising. A few clarifying asks from Legal before we finalize the MAP: 

1) DPA: we will circulate redlines but need confirmation that Redwood can sign an appendix that limits retention for specified Helios tenant IDs to 90 days for non-production data; production data must remain configurable up to 7 years for regulatory holds.
2) SOC 2: can Redwood provide the Type II period dates and any open exceptions? We also want a confirmed contact who will perform a short walkthrough for our auditor (30–45 minutes).
3) Evidence cadence: can you commit to delivery dates in the MAP? We need at least two artifacts by 6/20 to keep our internal timeline.

Please attach the DPA_redlines_20280630.docx when you respond.

Regards,
Ana Torres
Senior Counsel, Helios Financial

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@heliosfin.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@heliosfin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Jun 2028 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP: security gating & evidence cadence – first pass

Ana — attaching the requested artifacts and a draft MAP (summary below; full MAP + matrix uploaded to Drive):

Attachments included: SOC2_Type2-summary.pdf; DPA_redlines_20280630.docx; evidence_matrix_v3.csv

Draft MAP summary (6-week cadence):
- Week 0 (6/6): DPA redlines in Docx submitted; evidence matrix v3 uploaded; SOC 2 summary attached.
- Week 1 (6/10): Security Ops walkthrough for Helios auditor (30 min) — Marcus to lead.
- Week 2 (6/16): Deliver CAIQ export + control mapping artifacts (owner links)
- Week 3 (6/23): Deliver samples for KV encryption config and runbook excerpt
- Week 4–5 (6/24–7/6): Address DPA redline comments; finalize retention appendix for tenant-scope 90-day test telemetry and configurable production retention up to 7 years.

Retention appendix note: Redwood will implement tenant-scoped retention via the x-helio-test:true flag for non-production traces. We will include an audit trail for purge jobs and a route for Helios to request extended hold only via signed archival request (DocuSign).

Next steps: Please confirm the auditor walkthrough slot (Marcus proposes 6/10 10:00–10:30 PT) and confirm if Helios legal will accept the tenant-scoped appendix approach so we can lock dates.

Thanks — Mina
